'''Jiri Sools''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who, upon a visit to [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]], was educated in the "errors of monogamy" by "a double-jointed [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[cafarel]] named [[Lissahl]]."
